market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to range-trade with tech outperforming and materials/financials lagging. RBA rate-hike fears and Sydney housing stress cap upside. Diesel/energy volatility adds noise. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a tight band pending CPI and RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift in China (robots over iron ore) and persistent fiscal pressure cap mining and bank multiples. Gold, LNG, and AI/tech offer relative outperformance. Housing correction may deepen before stabilising. Migration policy lock-in supports long-term demand but strains infrastructure.
